prerequisites: Linear and quadratic equations/inequalities and simple systems
Euclidean geometry (axioms, criteria for triangles) and analytic geometry (lines, circles, ellypses, parabolas and hyperbolas)

learning_outcomes.text: Learning mathematical language and basic techniques of one variable mathematical analysis, including limits of functions and sequences, convergence of series, differentiation and (Riemann and generalized) integration.

syllabus_topics: Basic topology: neighborhood, open and closed sets
Limits and basic properties (with rigorous statements and proofs)
Continuous functions and their basic properties
Derivative and their basic properties (with rigorous statements and proofs)
Higher order derivatives and convexity of a function
Riemann integral and computations of real integrals
teaching_methods: Use of technological tools (moodle and/or other educational tools, software, videos, quizzes, wooclap)
assessment_rules: The exam consists of a written test with exercises and open theory questions. The test is passed if both the exercises part and the theory part are sufficient. If either part is insufficient, the whole exam is failed. In some cases, a short supplementary test (theory or/and exercises) can be offered if parts are slightly insufficient or if there is a large discrepancy between exercises and theory. The final grade will depend on the overall evaluation of the written test and the integration.
institution: Università degli Studi di Padova — Information Engineering (L-8)
degree: Laurea in Information Engineering (Information Engineering), classe L-8 R Ingegneria dell'informazione
